What counts as a credit?
Every time you process a document through Reducto — for example, when you parse, extract, split, or edit a file — you use credits. Each API call consumes credits based on the operation type, configurations, and the number of pages processed.

For a detailed breakdown of how credit usage works, see our Credit Usage Overview.
